title: SEC EDGAR Filings Feed: 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, Form 4, Form D, S-1
description: Returns SEC EDGAR filings as one JSON row per filing, from official sec.gov / data.sec.gov endpoints. With tickers or CIKs it reads each company's filing history; with neither it returns the latest market-wide filings of the chosen form types. Example: {"tickers":["AAPL","TSLA"],"formTypes":["8-K","10-Q"],"filedWithinDays":30}. Pricing: $0.002 per filing row.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Optional stock tickers, e.g. ["AAPL","NVDA"]. Resolved to CIKs with the SEC ticker file.

ciks.title: CIK numbers
ciks.description: Optional SEC Central Index Keys, e.g. ["320193"]. Leave tickers and CIKs empty to get latest filings across all companies.

formTypes.title: Form types
formTypes.description: Form types to include, e.g. ["8-K","10-K","10-Q","4","D","S-1","13F-HR","SC 13D"]. Empty = all forms (company mode only; market-wide mode needs at least one).

filedWithinDays.title: Filed within (days)
filedWithinDays.description: Only filings from the last N days. 0 = no limit (company mode returns the ~1000 most recent).

onlyNew.title: Only new since last run
onlyNew.description: true = skip filings delivered by an earlier run with the same tickers/CIKs/forms. Use with a schedule for an alert feed.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum rows (1-5000). You pay per row, so this caps cost: 100 rows = $0.20.

contactEmail.title: Contact email for SEC User-Agent
contactEmail.description: Optional. SEC asks automated clients to identify themselves; this email is sent in the User-Agent header to sec.gov only.
